1.e4 c5 2.Na3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Bc4.strategy: A gambit: the bishop aims at f7 and is backed by the knight on a3, but the d4 pawn stays with Black and White has no immediate way to win it back. White plays for quick development and pressure on f7 against a pawn.
1.e4 c5 2.Na3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Bc4.name: Sicilian Defence: Kronberger Variation, Nemeth Gambit
